primary.$description: the accessible dark-theme action colour, not the identity colour: `brand` keeps Soft Violet (violet.400). Soft Violet as text measured 4.43:1 on bg-primary/10 over `card`, 3.72:1 on the same tint over `muted` and 4.31:1 on `accent` once the Kinetic Weave dark surfaces rose to navy.800/navy.700, so it fails AA as a foreground. indigo.300 is the light step of Electric Indigo and measures 7.58:1 on `card`, 6.28:1 on `accent` and 5.13:1 at the worst tint. Mirrors light, where the action is indigo.600 rather than the identity indigo.500.

muted.$description: Kinetic Weave v1 semantic role; existing token name preserved.

muted-foreground.$description: secondary text. Kinetic Weave v1 moved this off navy.100: at 88% lightness it measured 13.26:1 on --background beside a 17.31:1 --foreground, so dark had almost no secondary/primary hierarchy where light's pair is 5.10:1 against 15.84:1. navy.200 measures 9.31:1 on --background, 7.27:1 on --card, 6.02:1 on --muted and 4.94:1 at the worst composited tint this repository renders (bg-primary/10 over --muted) — comfortably above AA everywhere while reading as subordinate to --foreground. This is also what lets the MultiSelect placeholder sit below its selected value: check:composite-visual measures the placeholder at 9.38:1 and the value at 9.90:1 on the rendered dark field, where navy.100 put the placeholder at 13.37:1 and inverted the hierarchy. That 0.52 margin is deliberate but narrow — a future change to --secondary or --secondary-foreground can close it, so the gate, not this description, is the contract.

destructive.$description: red.300 was sized for the old near-black dark page; on the Kinetic Weave navy.800 `card` it measures 4.33:1 and 3.87:1 on its own 10% tint, both below AA. red.200 measures 6.50:1 on `card`, 5.39:1 on `muted` and 5.46:1 on its own 10% tint over `card`; `destructive-foreground` on the solid fill is 8.59:1.

border.$description: the Kinetic Weave boundary step. Was `blue.400`, a slate-blue (hue 204) the rebrand never revisited, while every dark surface moved to navy (hue 222). `navy.600` was chosen to match `blue.400`'s weight exactly — 2.53:1 against `background`, 1.98:1 against `card`, the same figures — so this stays the deliberately subtle boundary that ACCESSIBILITY-AUDIT.md §A3 describes and keeps its KNOWN_SUB3 entry. Hue only; nothing about the visual weight changed.

input.$description: the input outline. Same hue-only correction as `border`, which it has always matched: `blue.400` → `navy.600` at identical measured weight (2.53:1 on `background`).

ring.$description: focus ring — tracks dark --primary, as it has since the azure palette.

tertiary.$description: the Switch off-track. Hue-only correction from the slate-blue `blue.400` to `navy.600` at identical measured weight (1.98:1 against `card`). This stays below 3:1 **by design** — switch.tsx and check-contrast.mjs' KNOWN_SUB3 both record that the thumb's travel and `aria-checked` carry the state, not the track's contrast — so the tracked SC 1.4.11 exception is unchanged, neither removed nor broadened. Raising the track to 3:1 would be a separate, cross-platform design call.

scrim.$description: black at 60%: a dark page is already near-black, so 40% would barely dim it; 60% keeps the modal separated from what is behind it.

on-info-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted info surface. Dark: one step lighter than `info`, for the same reason `on-success-container` and `on-destructive-container` are — a 10% tint lightens a dark surface *toward* light text, which erodes the ratio rather than helping it. Measured unrounded on an `info`/10 tint: `blue.75` is 5.6916:1 over `muted`, 6.8255:1 over `card` and 8.9926:1 over the page, and every emitted platform value stays within 0.07 of those (web's integer HSL is the lowest at 5.6301:1). `info`'s own step, which this used to be, is 4.4847:1 over `muted`. Until 2026-11-05 this token was that step and this description claimed it cleared AA, because check-contrast.mjs rounded the composite to 8-bit before measuring and so printed 4.50:1 — see that script's header.

on-success-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted success surface. Dark: one step lighter than `success`, which measures 4.4982:1 on its own 15% tint over `muted` — at the AA threshold rather than clearly over it. This is 6.03:1 at the same worst case.

on-warning-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted warning surface. Dark: the same step as `warning`, which already clears AA on the dark tint (7.38:1 at its worst case) because a tint lightens a dark surface away from light text.

on-destructive-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted error surface. Dark: one step lighter than `destructive`, so the container text stays distinct from the status colour itself. red.150 measures 5.57:1 on a destructive/10 tint over `muted` and 6.68:1 over `card`.

on-info-container.$description: text on a tinted info surface (bg-info/10). Dark: one step lighter than --info (blue.75), because --info's own step falls to 4.4847:1 on an info/10 tint over --muted. Light counterpart is darker — see color.light.json.

muted-on-container.$description: secondary text on a tinted container. Dark: deliberately one step lighter than --muted-foreground, which Kinetic Weave moved to navy.200. The two roles diverge because a 10% tint lightens a dark surface toward the text, eroding the ratio: navy.100 holds 7.04:1 on the worst tint this repository renders (bg-primary/10 over --muted) where navy.200 would fall to 4.94:1. Darkening is a light-mode problem only. Light counterpart is darker — see color.light.json.

brand.$description: Kinetic Weave v1 semantic role; existing token name preserved.

brand-foreground.$description: Kinetic Weave v1 semantic role; existing token name preserved.

action.$description: the interactive colour (buttons, selected controls). Defaults to `primary`; override `--action` on its own to split the interactive colour from `primary`.

action-hover.$description: explicit hover fill for native ports: `action` at 90% over `background` (#BBB3FF over #0C1229). The web renders this as `bg-action/90`; `check:contrast` asserts the two agree.

action-pressed.$description: explicit pressed fill for native ports: `action` at 85% over `background`. The web renders this as `bg-action/85`; `check:contrast` asserts the two agree and that text on it clears AA.

focus.$description: focus indicator colour. Defaults to `ring`; override `--focus` to theme focus separately.

link.$description: inline link / Link-button text colour. Defaults to `primary`.
